Making good food accessible around the clock.

Our mission

A hot meal should not depend on the time of day.

Shift work, late lectures and busy days have one thing in common: restaurants and canteens are not always open when people are ready to eat.

LECKERDING combines refrigerated, pre-packaged meals with integrated heating and cashless payment. Full meals become available right on site, without a staffed kitchen.

Our founder

Shawn Veldhuis

Founder & Managing Director · LECKERDING GmbH

LECKERDING grew from a simple observation: access to an affordable hot meal is often limited exactly when it is needed most. That sparked the idea of bringing reliable food options directly into everyday spaces.

“Our aim is to make quality meals as easy to access as a cup of coffee – only more substantial and useful in everyday life.”

In our LECKERDING journal we share perspectives on workplace meals.
